children: Rekor Systems adjourned its 2026 Annual Meeting due to lack of quorum and reconvened it for October 16, 2026, at 10:30 a.m. ET.
The Annual Meeting was adjourned on Sept. 11, 2026, because a quorum was not present; reconvened meeting set for Oct. 16, 2026 at 10:30 a.m. ET.
The Reconvened Meeting will be held in person at Rekor Systems headquarters in Columbia, Maryland, and virtually via live webcast.
The record date remains March 25, 2026; previously submitted proxies will be voted at the Reconvened Meeting unless revoked.
Stockholders who have not yet voted are encouraged to vote promptly using the instructions in the company’s proxy materials.
